technology_name: Gravity Compensation Hydraulic Damper for Postural Transients
model: uncertainty -> experiment -> information gained -> technical decision -> capital avoided/unlocked (directive section 17)
dominant_uncertainty: Whether EITHER of the two unestablished differentiators (response speed, proportional control) is clinically material against the incumbent ASD — the package's entire reason to exist, currently at materiality evidence NONE.

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Clinical materiality of the response-speed differentiator (0.4 s class difference; postural transitions take 1-3 s)
uncertainty_inventory.class: DIFFERENTIATOR_LEVEL (kills the package's first reason to exist)
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: The recorded 3-arm bench loop with physiological transition-rate steps
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: Measured response-time difference vs a real ASD at physiological rates — the modeled 0.4 s either survives or vanishes
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether the first differentiator justifies ANY further development
uncertainty_inventory.capital_at_stake: The recorded $15K experiment vs the entire damper development chain it gates

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Clinical materiality of proportional control (flow smoothing vs binary anti-siphon action)
uncertainty_inventory.current_state: UNESTABLISHED — no model of ICP oscillation vs binary switching exists
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: The same bench loop's proportional_error endpoint (flow-trace smoothness vs ASD)
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: Whether continuous proportional resistance measurably smooths postural flow excursions vs the ASD's action
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: The R339-recorded binary decision: both-null -> repair pipeline -> cemetery

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Target-flow accuracy vs ASD (modeled: ASD closer in 3/4 postures)
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: The same bench loop (identical instrument on both arms, Constitution Art. XLVII)
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: The modeled 3/4-posture disadvantage confirmed or refuted on hardware
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether the package is sellable AT ALL if the differentiators are only weakly positive

uncertainty_inventory.uncertainty: Clinical harm model of postural transients (problem existence — Constitution Art. XX)
uncertainty_inventory.current_state: The premise that postural TRANSIENTS (as opposed to steady-state over-drainage, which ASDs address) cause clinically meaningful harm is not established in the package records
uncertainty_inventory.resolvable_by: Clinical literature review (owner-gated) preceding or parallel to the bench loop
uncertainty_inventory.information_gained_if_run: A problem-existence verdict before more mechanism money is spent
uncertainty_inventory.decision_it_changes: Whether the bench result is interpretable as an improvement at all

cheapest_decisive_action: The recorded $15K / 8-week 3-arm mock-CSF-loop experiment — it resolves all three first uncertainties in ONE protocol with a real ASD on the bench; the cheapest possible exit from a package whose differentiators are entirely unestablished.
what_a_buyer_buys_by_funding_it: A measured kill-or-survive verdict on the only two claims the technology has — against the incumbent device, on identical instrumentation, blinded. The recorded decision rule makes the negative outcome actionable (repair/cemetery) rather than ambiguous; that is the entire value: $15K converts two UNESTABLISHED claims and one modeled disadvantage into measured facts.
explicit_not_claimed: No monetary VOI figure beyond the recorded $15K protocol cost; the avoided-capital chain beyond the experiment is not quantified in the records and is not invented here (Constitution Art. XXVII/VI)
next_information_gain_order: 1. Clinical-materiality margin pre-registration + postural-transient harm literature review (owner-gated prerequisite)
2. The 3-arm bench loop ($15K/8 weeks, recorded) — the decisive contract
3. Only on a positive outcome: proportional-damper manufacturing feasibility (recorded as unvalidated)
